items.t: KBI동양철관 "스페이스X에 강관 1000t 공급"
items.fullText: 산업 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 KBI동양철관 "스페이스X에 강관 1000t 공급" 입력 2026.10.19 09:27 수정 2026.10.19 09:30 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 이정선 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. KBI그룹의 KBI동양철관이 미국의 민간 우주탐사 및 항공우주 기업인 SpaceX의 로켓 발사 시설에 들어가는 강관 950여t을 납품 중이라고 19일 밝혔다. 이번 납품은 스페이스X가 플로리다와 텍사스주에서 운영하는 위성 발사체 시설에 사용되는 강관으로, KBI동양철관 천안공장과 충주공장에서 제작됐다. 납품 물량은 올해 4월에 640t과 이달 2차 205t, 3차 105t으로 구성된다. SpaceX에 공급한 강관은 로켓 발사 시 발생하는 막대한 열에 의한 충격을 줄이기 위해 대량의 물을 분사하는 '워터 디리지 시스템(Water Deluge System)'에 사용되는 고강도(High grade) 강종의 강관으로 발사대 설비의 안전과 직결되는 자재다. 이곽우 KBI동양철관 대표는 "지난 3월 제작 공정 검증을 위한 공정 실사를 진행해 품질을 인정받았다"며 "미국의 대표적인 우주탐사기업에 대한 납품 실적을 확보함으로써, 스페이스X의 추가 물량 발주 시에도 유리한 위치에서 수주에 나설 수 있을 것"이라고 말했다. 이정선 중기선임기자 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이정선 기자 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 반도체·2차전지용 '맞춤형 특수장비' 강자, 제이피이노베이션 반도체와 2차전지, 화장품 등의 제조공정에는 다양한 원료를 정밀하고 고르게 혼합하고 반응·여과·건조하... 2026.10.19 09:00 2 반도체인사이트 CXMT 3분기 매출 7배 폭증…삼전닉스 맹추격 중국 창신메모리테크놀로지(CXMT)의 지난 3분기 실적이 메모리 슈퍼사이클을 타고 1년 만에 일곱 배 늘어난... 2026.10.18 16:55 3 반도체인사이트 엔비디아, AI PC 'RTX 스파크' 국내 출시…"에이전트 AI 시대 가속화" 16일 서울 삼성동 코엑스에서 열린 엔비디아 노트북 'RTX 스파크' 출시 행사장. 이 노트북에 "영상에서 젠슨황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 나오는 부분만 잘라 줘"라고 입력하자 연동된 모... 2026.10.16 21:08 ADVERTISEMENT 많이 본 뉴스 1 1억 넘는데도…"골프치러 왔어요" 우르르 몰려든 이유가 2026.10.18 09:04 2 "폭스바겐 공장 닫고 거리도 불탔다"…유럽 '몰락' 시작됐나 2026.10.18 17:40 3 "회사 안 다녀도 월 5000만원 벌어요"…요즘 뜨는 '이 직업' 2026.10.18 17:13 4 러시아서 '초대박' 났다…80억개 불티나게 팔린 라면 2026.10.18 06:00 5 "이것까지 5000원이라고?"…다이소 파격 행보에 '깜짝' 2026.10.18 07:30 ADVERTISEMENT 이 시각 관심정보 AD ADVERTISEMENT --> ADVERTISEMENT

TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
items.d: A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:55 PM PDT · October 17, 2026 Image Credits: Tierney L. Cross/The Washington Post/Bloomberg / Getty Images Anthony Ha TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms, with TikTok banning the film’s advertising account. According to a story in The Hollywood Reporter , the documentary’s distributor Bleecker Street was recently notified by TikTok that the account had received a “permanent suspension” due to its political content. TechCrunch has reached out to TikTok for comment. Ads promoting the trailer for “Musk” — directed by Oscar-winner filmmaker Alex Gibney — were initially rejected by Meta and YouTube as well , though those platforms eventually allowed the ad, with Meta blaming the rejection on “an error.” Gibney recently confirmed that the film’s international distributor Universal had wavered in its plans to release “Musk,” though it’s now moving forward. X, which Musk owns, has refused to carry ads for “Musk.” TikTok’s U.S. operations are partly owned by Larry Ellison — who, like Musk, has been a notable supporter of President Donald Trump. “Musk” opened in just four theaters last weekend and is now rolling out more broadly. Next year, it’s supposed to stream on HBO — now part of Paramount/Skydance and led by Ellison’s son David . items.t: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
items.d: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.
items.fullText: Tech News Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays The electric sports car performed aerial stunts using thrusters developed with SpaceX, but it’s still years from production, and its flying features aren’t approved for public roads. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Tesla unveils its next generation 'flying' Roadster 03:33 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 16, 2026, 11:58 AM EDT By Chris Perez Elon Musk showed off a new vehicle prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters. The Tesla Roadster made its debut eight years after it was first announced. The company has yet to announce a price or release date, though the Tesla and SpaceX CEO said production would not begin until 2028. In a stunt-filled demonstration at a SpaceX testing facility in Texas, Musk told the live audience that what they were about to see “was not AI or SI.” The vehicle, a collaboration between Tesla and SpaceX, then slowly drove up a curved ramp shaped like half of a roller coaster loop before accelerating and launching itself off the ramp, hurdling over five other Tesla vehicles and bringing itself to a soft landing in a cloud of condensation using cold-gas thrusters. “Well, it worked!” Musk said after the stunt, adding that “it’s not necessarily a safety-optimized car.” Tesla Tesla says a fan-based suction system creates downforce to hold the vehicle against the road’s surface, while self-refilling cold-gas thrusters power its airborne maneuvers. Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military amid Trump pressure
items.d: Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations.
items.fullText: War in Ukraine Ukraine says new Starlink restrictions disrupt military as it reels from intel gaps and Trump clash Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Zelenskyy slams Trump over deal for Russian diesel 01:32 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 14, 2026, 8:51 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 14, 2026, 3:55 PM EDT By Abigail Williams , Dan De Luce , Gabe Gutierrez , Yuliya Talmazan and Jane Lytvynenko Ukraine has accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of undermining its ability to defend itself by limiting Starlink internet services as it reeled from intense Russian ballistic missile attacks that it said came without the usual warning from allies. Musk put the responsibility for the restrictions on President Donald Trump’s shoulders on social media , saying the military version of Starlink, called Starshield, is owned and controlled by the U.S. government. “Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS,” Musk said. A spokesperson for President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told NBC News that the limitations remained in place late Wednesday. Facing pressure from Trump to halt strikes on Russia’s energy industry, Kyiv and its backers have worried that Washington could cut off battlefield support to try to force it into concessions at the negotiating table. Ukrainian officials and their European partners were already scrambling to understand the status of U.S. intelligence-sharing after the lack of alert ahead of two Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv this week, two Ukrainian and two European officials told NBC News. Ukrainian firefighters extinguish a blaze at the site of a Russian missile strike at an apartment building in Kyiv on Wednesday amid the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Genya Savilov / AFP via Getty Trump insisted the U.S. was still sharing intelligence
